About Me

I'm a mobile app developer with 3+ years of professional experience building, architecting and shipping cross-platform applications. I've launched nine consumer-facing apps end-to-end — owning everything from ideation and technical architecture through development, testing, deployment, store compliance and ongoing maintenance.

I take a product-led, ownership-driven approach to engineering, with a strong emphasis on performance, scalability and user experience. I'm comfortable defining technical direction, collaborating closely with product and design teams, and iterating based on real-world analytics and user feedback.
